runtime: duration of the film (e.g., 2 hr 7 mins)
synopsis: brief summary of the film's plot
release year: year the film was first released theatrically
cast: list of principal cast members (actor and character)
genre: primary genre or genres of the film
title: name of the movie
writers: list of writer names (screenwriters, play authors, etc.)
music composer: name(s) of the composer(s) of the score
theatrical release date: official release date of the movie
